words.meaning: A utensil with a broad, flat, flexible blade used for mixing, spreading, and lifting foods.
sentences: She used a silicone spatula to scrape the last bit of batter from the bowl.
Flip the pancake carefully using a broad spatula.
Make sure to clean the rubber spatula thoroughly after making the cake frosting.

words.meaning: A perforated bowl used to strain off liquid from cooked pasta or washed vegetables.
sentences: Pour the hot spaghetti into the colander to drain the excess water.
He placed the freshly washed strawberries in a colander to dry.
A stainless steel colander is an essential tool in any modern kitchen.

words.meaning: To cook liquid or food in liquid gently at or just below the boiling point.

translations.hindi: धीमी आंच पर पकाना (Dheemi aanch par pakana)

sentences: Reduce the flame and let the soup simmer for twenty minutes.
The tomato sauce needs to simmer gently to allow the spices to blend well.
She covered the pot and allowed the curry to simmer until the meat was tender.
